sources.snippet: The AutoTokenizer class uses heuristics to determine the type of tokenizer that should be used based on the architecture and configuration of the pre-trained model. This can be useful when working with a variety of pre-trained models, because it allows you to use the appropriate tokenizer without having to manually select one for each model.
